Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. And 3 Others
Counsel for Applicant :- Sanjeev Kumar Yadav,Birendra Singh,Mohit Singh
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Rajesh Kumar Singh,Ram Bahadur
Hon'ble Sameer Jain,J.
1.

Heard Ms. Swati Singh, Advocate holding brief of Sri Virendra Singh, learned counsel for the applicant, Sri Vijay Kumar Kashyap holding brief of Sri Ram Bahadur Kushwaha learned counsel for the informant and Sri Santosh Nigam learned A.G.A. for the State.
2.

The instant bail application has been filed on behalf of the applicant with the prayer to release him on bail in Case Crime No.694 of 2022, under Sections 147, 323, 504, 506, 354-A, 376, 427, 452 I.P.C. and 3/4 POCSO Act, Police Station Kotwali Hata, District Kushi Nagar, during pendency of the trial.

3. FIR of the present case was lodged against the applicant and others on 18.11.2022 through an application under Section 156 (3) Cr.P.C. dated 30.09.2022 and according to the F.I.R. applicant on 21.09.2022 after dragging the daughter of the informant in sugarcane field committed rape with her and thereafter when informant and her family members made complaint then applicant and his Vipin Yadav vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 18 September, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/41778451/

sentences.text: 1 family members assaulted them and due to the assault made by them the victim i.e. daughter of the informant and her father sustained injuries.
4. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that totally on the basis of false allegation of rape and assault, applicant along with his family members have been made accused in the present matter.

She further submits that incident said to have taken place on 21.09.2022 and even application under Section 156 (3) Cr.P.C. was moved on 30.09.2022 i.e. after about nine days, this fact itself shows that F.I.R. of the present case is based on false and frivolous facts.
5.

Learned counsel for the applicant further submits that actually informant and her husband i.e.
father of the prosecutrix assaulted the applicant and his family members and when in spite of best effort of the applicant's side their F.I.R. could not be lodged then on 26.07.2022, mother of the applicant moved an application under Section 156 (3) Cr.P.C. against the parents of the prosecutrix and thereafter on 27.08.2022 F.I.R. of the applicant's side was lodged which has been annexed as Annexure-6 to the affidavit and only due to this enmity subsequently, applicant has been made accused in the present matter along with his family members.
6. She further submits that although as per the prosecution victim was around 13 years old but according to the doctor her radiological age was around 18 to 22 years and this clearly suggests that she was major.

She further submits the story of the rape narrated by the informant in the F.I.R. and by the victim in her both the statements recorded under Sections 161 & 164 Cr.P.C., appears to be highly improbable and no reliance can be placed on such version.
She further submits victim did not sustain any injury on her private part and therefore, she refused for her internal examination.
7. Learned counsel for the applicant further submits that applicant is not having any previous criminal history and he is in jail since 04.01.2023, i.e, for more than nine months.

8. Per contra, learned AGA as well as learned counsel for the informant opposed the prayerfor bail and submits that as per the admit card of the High School victim was hardly 13 years old and she in her both the statement recorded under Sections 161 & 164 Cr.P.C. made allegation of rape against the applicant but both the counsels could not dispute the fact that as per doctor, the radiological age of the victim was between 18 to 22 years and before lodging the F.I.R. of present case the mother of the applicant has lodged F.I.R. against the informant and her husband in the month of August,
2022.
9. I have heard both the parties and perused the record of the case.

10. Although, victim in her both the statements recorded under Sections 161 & 164 Cr.P.C. made allegation of rape against the applicant and according to the admit card of the victim of High School,
she was around 13 years old but during investigation when her ossification test was conducted then doctor found her radiological age between 18 to 22 years.
11. Further, story narrated by the victim and the informant appears to be quite improbable.

Further,
before lodging the F.I.R. of the present case, a F.I.R. was lodged by the mother of the applicant Vipin Yadav vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 18 September, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/41778451/
2 against the parents of the prosecutrix including the informant of the case i.e. her mother in the month of August, 2022.

sentences.text: 12. Therefore, considering the facts and circumstances of the present case, discussed above, in my view, the applicant is entitled to be released on bail.
13. Accordingly, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, the instant bail application is allowed.

14. Let the applicant- Vipin Yadav be released on bail in the aforesaid case on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:-
(i) The applicant shall appear before the trial court on the dates fixed, unless his personal presence is exempted.
(ii) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly, make inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
(iii) The applicant shall not indulge in any criminal and anti-social activity.
15. In case of breach of any of the above condition, the prosecution will be at liberty to move an application before this Court for cancellation of the bail of the applicant.

16. It is clarified that the observations made herein are limited to the facts brought in by the parties pertaining to the disposal of bail application and the said observations shall have no bearing on the merits of the case during trial.

Order Date :- 18.9.2023 Jitendra  Vipin Yadav vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 18 September, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/41778451/
